options.label: 1600s Edo Japan · Samurai & Yoshiwara Lanterns
options.rule: everything in view belongs to 17th-century Edo-period Japan: sliding shoji paper screens, woven tatami reed mats, warm paper-lantern and oil-lamp light, lacquered wood, silk kimono and haori robes, and katana scabbards.

options.label: 1890s Parisian Belle Époque · Moulin Rouge & Velvet
options.rule: everything in view belongs to 1890s Parisian Belle Époque cabaret: Art Nouveau wrought-iron flourishes, crimson velvet curtains, warm gaslight and incandescent bulbs, silk corsets, lace stockings, and champagne flutes.

options.label: 2000s Y2K Era · Metallic Gloss, Flip Phones & Low-Rise
options.rule: everything in view belongs to the early-2000s Y2K era: silver metallic and translucent plastic surfaces, flip phones, rimless tinted sunglasses, low-rise denim, velour tracksuits, and high-gloss lip shine.

options.label: 2099 Neo-Tokyo Cyberpunk · Holograms, Chrome & Wet Neon
options.rule: everything in view belongs to 2099 Neo-Tokyo cyberpunk: towering holographic kanji advertisements, rain-slicked carbon-fiber and chrome surfaces, sub-dermal gold cyberware lines, and glowing techwear.

options.label: Timeless Gothic Aristocracy · Candlelit Stone & Velvet
options.rule: everything in view belongs to a timeless gothic aristocratic estate: vaulted stone arches, towering stained-glass windows, silver candelabras, black silk and velvet couture, and moonlit mist.

options.label: 2150 Solarpunk Ecotopia · Sunlit Glass, Gold & Hanging Gardens
options.rule: everything in view belongs to a sunlit solarpunk future: sweeping Art-Nouveau glass-and-brass arches, lush hanging botanical gardens, flowing linen-and-gold attire, and warm natural daylight.

options.label: 1915 Taishō-Era Japan · Gaslit Wooden Machiya, Silk Haori & Wisteria Lanterns
options.rule: everything in view belongs to 1915 Taishō-era Japan: traditional dark-wood machiya architecture, paper shoji screens, glowing wisteria lanterns, patterned silk haori coats over gakuran uniforms, and warm gaslight.

options.label: 1000 AD Heian Imperial Court · Layered Silk Robes, Gold Leaf Screens & Cherry Blossoms
options.rule: everything in view belongs to the imperial court of Heian-period Japan: gleaming cypress wood floors, painted gold-leaf folding screens, bamboo blinds, and flowing multi-layered silk kimono robes.

options.label: 2099 Neo-Shibuya Megacity · Towering Hologram Skyscrapers, Cyberware & Rain
options.rule: everything in view belongs to 2099 Neo-Shibuya: towering megastructures draped in 100-foot 3D kanji holograms, rain-slicked neon crosswalks, cybernetic chrome accents, and sleek techwear.

options.label: Contemporary Present Day
options.rule: contemporary present-day architecture, smartphones, sleek modern interiors, and current tailoring
